title: Quality Control Inspector
summary: A quality control inspector checks raw material, parts on the line and finished goods in a factory against drawings and specifications, using measuring instruments and sampling plans. The role sits in the plant's quality department, reports to a quality engineer or head, and raises non-conformance reports when parts fail.
dailyDuties: Inspect incoming material against the quality plan and supplier documents
Measure in-process parts with vernier, micrometer and gauges
Do final inspection before dispatch using the sampling plan
Raise non-conformance reports and hold rejected material
Fill inspection reports and quality records for ISO 9001
Check that instruments are calibrated before use
Join root cause discussions on repeat defects

skills.expectation: Carry out incoming, in-process and final inspection against the quality plan
Measure parts with vernier, micrometer, height gauge and plug or thread gauges
Read drawings and tolerances to decide accept or reject
Pick samples to the agreed AQL sampling plan
Raise non-conformance reports, hold rejected material and follow up corrective actions
Fill inspection reports and quality records the ISO 9001 system needs
Use only calibrated instruments and keep the calibration list up to date
Help find the root cause of defects with why-why or fishbone analysis
Plot control charts and support gauge R&R studies
Run or read CMM reports for complex parts
Keep inspection data and rejection trends in Excel
Follow 5S and safety rules on the shop floor
Explain rejections clearly to production and suppliers
